description: This file defines the SlidingTabLayout class, a custom UI component for Android that provides tab indicators synchronized with a ViewPager. It allows customization of tab views, colors, and interaction behavior. The class manages tab creation, styling, and scroll position updates based on ViewPager page changes.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that displays tab indicators synchronized with a ViewPager, providing customizable tab views and colors.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface to customize indicator and divider colors for individual tabs.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for complete control over tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the selected tab indicator; supports multiple colors for circular pattern.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets colors for tab dividers; supports multiple colors.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to synchronize the layout with page scroll events.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Specifies a custom layout for tab views and the ID of the TextView within it.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Links the layout to a ViewPager, creating tab views based on the pager's adapter.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView for tabs if no custom view is specified.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Populates the tab strip with tabs corresponding to the ViewPager's pages.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the layout to ensure the selected tab is visible, with optional offset.
